note: Views Simple Math Field registers (via hook_views_data) a #global table 'views_simple_math_field' exposing the field handler field_views_simple_math_field (SimpleMathField extends NumericField) and a sort views_simple_math_field_sort. No configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Per-field options are stored inside the view config under display_options.fields.<id>.fieldset_one.data_field (fields feeding the formula), fieldset_one.formula (the expression using @<field_id> tokens), and mute_logs (silence DivisionByZeroException logging). Values are computed in PHP at render time (getValue()) via the andileco/eval-math library; the sort runs in postExecute(). Medium/hard cases build namespaced views (vsmf_*) on the node base and read/write that real field config.

evals.prompt: In a Drupal view I want a column that is computed from two other numeric fields (e.g. a subtotal). Which field does the views_simple_math_field module add, and where do I find it when adding a field to the view?
evals.expected_output: Add the 'Global: Simple Math Field' field (handler id field_views_simple_math_field). It appears under the Global group. Tick the numeric fields to use and enter a formula; it outputs the computed value as a column.

evals.prompt: How do I reference other view fields inside a views_simple_math_field formula? Give an example expression.
evals.expected_output: Reference each selected field by an @<field_id> token shown beside its checkbox, e.g. (@field_price + @field_tax) / @field_qty. The expression is evaluated with the EvalMath (andileco/eval-math) library.

evals.prompt: What external library does views_simple_math_field use to evaluate formulas, and what setting stops it logging a database error when a formula divides by zero?
evals.expected_output: It uses the andileco/eval-math (EvalMath) PHP library. The per-field 'Mute database logs for this field' checkbox (mute_logs) suppresses the watchdog log a DivisionByZeroException would otherwise write.

evals.prompt: This site has a view with the machine name vsmf_known that uses a Simple Math Field. Inspect the live view configuration and report the exact formula configured on that Simple Math Field.
evals.expected_output: The formula is (@nid + @vid) / 2 - stored at views.view.vsmf_known display.default.display_options.fields.field_views_simple_math_field.fieldset_one.formula.

evals.prompt: The view vsmf_mute on this site has a Simple Math Field. Inspect the live configuration: is database logging of division-by-zero errors muted for that field?
evals.expected_output: Yes, it is muted: the Simple Math Field's mute_logs option is 1 in views.view.vsmf_mute (display.default.display_options.fields.field_views_simple_math_field.mute_logs).

evals.prompt: The view with machine name vsmf_task on this site has no computed math column yet. Add a views_simple_math_field 'Simple Math Field' to its default display with a working formula, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a field keyed field_views_simple_math_field (plugin_id field_views_simple_math_field, table views_simple_math_field) to views.view.vsmf_task display.default.display_options.fields, with fieldset_one.data_field selecting at least one field and a non-empty fieldset_one.formula (e.g. '@nid * 2'). Save the view.

evals.prompt: The view vsmf_calc already has a Simple Math Field but its formula is empty. Configure that field's formula so it multiplies the node id (nid) by 100, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set views.view.vsmf_calc display.default.display_options.fields.field_views_simple_math_field.fieldset_one.formula to '@nid * 100' (must reference @nid and include 100), keeping nid in fieldset_one.data_field, and save the view.
